Although memory costs are expected to easily be the largest expense in the iPhone 18 Pro bill of materials, the same may not be true for the iPhone Duo. Here are the details.

Apple signs three-year exclusive deal with Samsung Display

Leaker Instant Digital said on Weibo today that Apple and Samsung Display have signed an exclusive three-year supply agreement for foldable panels.

The leaker noted that Samsung Display will be the exclusive supplier of foldable panels for the iPhone Duo "and its successors," with each panel costing around $250.

The leaker also mentioned that this is "one of the most expensive core components" of the device without a doubt.

Although there is currently no reliable information disclosing the expected bill of materials for the iPhone Duo, based on the cost distribution of displays, cameras, processors, memory, and other components, Apple has shared information about the materials used in the device, including how much recycled content is included.
